finding.scenario: A system-setting whitelist reload reassigned sync.Map and singleflight.Group while outbound requests still used their internal locks. The real SetSSRFWhitelistFromRaw and validator concurrency fixture produced four race reports before the fix.
finding.fix: Replace a single atomic pointer to an independently locked cache generation. In-flight results remain in the retired generation, and expired entries are removed only if they are still the same entry.

validation.controls: Concurrent whitelist reload and validation; cached allow revoked immediately for subsequent calls, deny removed on restoration; existing cache expiry, redirect, transport and DNS safety tests.

limits: In-flight calls retain their captured cache generation. This change does not add synchronous DNS cancellation or claim all utility and consumer modules audited. No live service or whitelist configuration was changed.
